KXNBA3PT.rules_secondary_base:
Note: If a player is inactive, or active but never takes the court, the market settles to a fair price. Once a player enters the game the market settles based on the player's made three-pointers recorded.

If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is cancelled or not started within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start, all markets will resolve to a fair price.

KXNBA3PT.rules_secondary_variant:
Important Information: This Contract is designated as protected. If the individual player enters the game during the first half of the game but does not enter the game after the conclusion of the first half, including any overtime period, this Contract resolves to the fair price prior to the opening tip of the game unless the player records the required number of threes, in which case this Contract settles based on actual statistics. If the player enters the game after the conclusion of the first half, this Contract settles based on actual statistics, regardless of first-half participation. Injury, an injury designation, or being ruled out is not required for protection.
